name: GPT-IMAGE-EDIT-1.5M
description: GPT-IMAGE-EDIT-1.5M is a publicly available dataset of over 1.5 million high-quality GPT-generated image editing triplets, unified from multiple sources. It supports benchmarking of multimodal diffusion architectures for instruction-guided image editing, analyzing robustness and performance across different conditioning methods and text encoders.
reputation: A very large public image-editing dataset that is likely to become useful for benchmarking instruction-guided editing, but it is still new and not yet broadly established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Dataset curated with output regeneration and instruction rewriting; benchmarks multiple diffusion architectures; highlights importance of conditioning methods and text encoders.
